scenicChapters.title: Hana Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 14 km this is Hana Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

hana-highway.story: Out of Kahului, one way: 94 km, roughly 1 h 32 in the saddle. It goes by way of Paia, Keanae and Wailua Falls. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

scenicChapters.title: Seematte → Sumpf
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 23 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-seematte-rorenhaab.story: From Hitzkirch it runs 156 km to Hitzkirch; allow about 2 h 41 of riding. On the way it passes Sumpf, Vorder Au, Technikum and Rorenhaab. The highest point is about 1,200 m.

places-abrigo-de-la-fuente-cueva-del-pel.story: A 306 km round trip from Nerpio - roughly 5 h 17 in the saddle. It goes by way of Andragulla I, Abrigo del Pozo III, Abrigo de los Cortijos and Cueva del Peliciego. The highest point is about 1,400 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
